measurements.build: 3.11.4 build#2 (warm fired, screen_start arrived before warm-ready)

conclusion: getDisplayMedia (847-1089ms) moved off the screen_start critical path: it now runs at session accept and overlaps the viewer window load. When the stream is already warm at screen_start, first frame is ~615ms. Worst case measured end-to-end 1722ms because the harness connects the viewer immediately after accept, leaving no overlap.
note: fps 0.8 in the last run reflects an idle VM desktop (delta engine sends only changes), not a stall; 91-94 frames were seen under load.
